vulnerability.name: CVE-2026-95619
vulnerability.description: libstdc++: integer overflow in the aligned operator new

statements.impact_statement: The only C++ runtime functions imported by binaries in the slim image are the plain operator new/new[]/delete, std::nothrow and the __cxa_* ABI helpers (Checked on the amd64 and arm64 v10.1.1-slim images (distroless cc-debian13 base, same Dockerfile as main)). No binary imports the aligned operator new (operator new(size_t, std::align_val_t)), and the HotSpot style guide forbids dynamic allocation of over-aligned types (https://github.com/openjdk/jdk/blob/master/doc/hotspot-style.md).

vulnerability.name: CVE-2026-114691
vulnerability.description: libstdc++: integer wrap in the std::vector<bool> constructor

statements.impact_statement: std::vector<bool> is a header-only template: the shared library in libstdc++6 contains no vector<bool> code, so the vulnerable code would sit in a binary that uses it, not in this package. The HotSpot style guide forbids the standard containers (https://github.com/openjdk/jdk/blob/master/doc/hotspot-style.md). Exploitation also needs an attacker-chosen element count close to SIZE_MAX.
